hypotheses.persona: Traditional morning reader with outdoor leisure habits
hypotheses.rationale: Consistent morning reading routine (newspaper/glasses) and outdoor coffee consumption persist. The lack of work items continues to support this non-working or retired profile.
Still possible if work is strictly digital and off-screen, but the phone appearing at the coffee table (not a desk) and no laptop sightings make this increasingly unlikely.
The rigid, identical schedule maintained for 9 days, including specific morning rituals, strongly suggests residency. A guest is highly unlikely to maintain such a pattern.
